description: Your AI design partner, right in ChatGPT. Generate logos, images, presentations, and videos from the chat, or upload your own image to edit. Just describe what you need, and Wixel generates professional designs that you can download and use right away, or fine-tune in the Wixel editor.

defaultPrompt: Create a logo for my artisanal food brand, Oliva Market. It should feel fun and bold, with bright colors.
